title: 燃烧原理与火灾分类
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/030_燃烧原理与火灾分类.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/030_燃烧原理与火灾分类/src.py

points.K1: 燃烧是放热发光的化学反应
points.K2: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
points.K3: 燃烧四面体：加上链式反应
points.K4: 热传递三种方式：传导、对流、辐射
points.K5: 灭火就是拿掉一个要素
points.K10: B类：液体和可熔化固体火灾
points.K12: E类带电、F类烹饪油脂火灾
points.S1: 初起火灾好扑救，扑不灭就撤离报警

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在由三个图标组成的燃烧三角旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fire triangle made of three icons, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲燃烧原理与火灾分类。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰看着酒精灯火焰发呆
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at the flame of an alcohol lamp on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰盯着酒精灯想：火是怎么烧起来的？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研盖上灯帽，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts the cap on the alcohol lamp and the flame goes out.
shots.narration: 小研盖上灯帽，火就灭了。为什么？

shots.section_title: 燃烧是放热发光的化学反应
shots.scene: 可燃物、氧气和热相遇，放出光和热的示意
shots.prompt_en: A fuel icon, an oxygen icon and a heat icon meet and release light and heat. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 燃烧是剧烈的化学反应。
overlay: 燃烧是放热发光的化学反应

shots.section_title: 燃烧是放热发光的化学反应
shots.scene: 火焰放出光和热，周围温度升高
shots.prompt_en: A flame gives off bright light and heat waves around it. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃物和氧反应，放出热和光。

shots.section_title: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.scene: 三角形三条边：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.prompt_en: A triangle whose three sides show a fuel icon, an oxygen icon and a spark icon. No text.
shots.narration: 燃烧要三样：可燃物、助燃物、点火源。
overlay: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源

shots.section_title: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.scene: 实验室里的溶剂瓶、纸张，作为可燃物
shots.prompt_en: Solvent bottles, paper and a cardboard box glow as fuel icons in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃物：溶剂、纸张、塑料。

shots.section_title: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.scene: 空气中的氧气分子，以及氧化剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen molecules float in the air next to an oxidizer bottle with a flame-over-circle icon. No text.
shots.narration: 助燃物最常见的是空气中的氧。

shots.section_title: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.scene: 氧化剂瓶倒在纸上，纸自己烧得更旺
shots.prompt_en: An oxidizer bottle spills onto paper and the paper burns more fiercely. No people.
shots.narration: 氧化剂也能助燃，不能和可燃物混放。

shots.section_title: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.scene: 明火、电火花、热板，作为点火源
shots.prompt_en: Three ignition source icons: an open flame, an electrical spark and a hot plate. No text.
shots.narration: 点火源：明火、电火花、热表面。

shots.section_title: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.scene: 三样分开放，什么也不发生
shots.prompt_en: Fuel, oxygen and a spark icon kept apart, nothing happens. No people.
shots.narration: 三样凑齐才着火，缺一不燃。

shots.section_title: 燃烧三角：可燃物、助燃物、点火源
shots.scene: 溶剂瓶远离加热板，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle moved away from a hot plate gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 所以溶剂要远离热源。

shots.section_title: 燃烧四面体：加上链式反应
shots.scene: 三角形变成四面体，第四面是链式反应
shots.prompt_en: The triangle unfolds into a tetrahedron; the fourth face shows a chain reaction icon. No text.
shots.narration: 再加上链式反应，就是燃烧四面体。
overlay: 燃烧四面体：加上链式反应

shots.section_title: 燃烧四面体：加上链式反应
shots.scene: 自由基接力传递的动画示意
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing particles pass energy along in a chain, keeping the flame going. No text.
shots.narration: 反应一环扣一环，火才能持续。

shots.section_title: 燃烧四面体：加上链式反应
shots.scene: 拿掉四面体任一面，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: One face is removed from the tetrahedron and the flame goes out. No text.
shots.narration: 四个要素缺一个，火就烧不起来。

shots.section_title: 热传递三种方式：传导、对流、辐射
shots.scene: 热沿着金属棒从一端传到另一端
shots.prompt_en: Heat travels along a metal rod from the flame end to the far end, shown by color change. No people.
shots.narration: 热的传递有三种方式：一是传导。
overlay: 热传递三种方式：传导、对流、辐射

shots.section_title: 热传递三种方式：传导、对流、辐射
shots.scene: 热烟气上升，沿天花板扩散
shots.prompt_en: Hot smoke rises and spreads along the ceiling with curved arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 二是对流，热烟气上升扩散。

shots.section_title: 热传递三种方式：传导、对流、辐射
shots.scene: 火焰向四周发出热射线，烤热旁边的纸箱
shots.prompt_en: A fire radiates heat rays that warm a nearby cardboard box. No people.
shots.narration: 三是辐射，隔着空气也能烤着东西。

shots.section_title: 热传递三种方式：传导、对流、辐射
shots.scene: 三种方式让火从一处蔓延到别处
shots.prompt_en: Fire spreads from one bench to the next by conduction, convection and radiation arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 火就是这样蔓延开的。

shots.section_title: 热传递三种方式：传导、对流、辐射
shots.scene: 可燃物与加热设备之间留出距离，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clear gap is kept between a heating device and nearby combustibles, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃物要远离热源，别被烤着。

shots.section_title: 灭火就是拿掉一个要素
shots.scene: 燃烧四面体旁边四只手分别拿走一个要素
shots.prompt_en: Four hands each remove one element from the fire tetrahedron. No faces, no text.
shots.narration: 灭火，就是拿掉一个要素。
overlay: 灭火就是拿掉一个要素

shots.section_title: 灭火就是拿掉一个要素
shots.scene: 四个灭火方法图标：冷却、隔离、窒息、抑制
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a water drop, a closed valve, a lid, and a powder cloud. No text.
shots.narration: 冷却、隔离、窒息、化学抑制。

shots.section_title: 冷却法和隔离法
shots.scene: 水浇在燃烧的木头上，温度计下降
shots.prompt_en: Water is poured on burning wood and a thermometer icon drops. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却法：用水等带走热量。

shots.section_title: 冷却法和隔离法
shots.scene: 关闭燃气阀门，火焰变小熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns off a gas valve and the flame shrinks and goes out. No faces.
shots.narration: 隔离法：关阀门，断掉燃料。

shots.section_title: 冷却法和隔离法
shots.scene: 把旁边的溶剂瓶移开
shots.prompt_en: Nearby solvent bottles are moved away from a small fire. No faces.
shots.narration: 移开旁边的可燃物，也是隔离。

shots.section_title: 窒息法和化学抑制法
shots.scene: 灭火毯盖住台面小火
shots.prompt_en: A fire blanket is laid over a small fire in a tray on the bench. No faces.
shots.narration: 窒息法：盖住它，隔绝空气。

shots.section_title: 窒息法和化学抑制法
shots.scene: 盖上酒精灯帽，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A cap is placed over an alcohol lamp flame and it goes out. No faces.
shots.narration: 盖灯帽、二氧化碳，都是窒息。

shots.section_title: 窒息法和化学抑制法
shots.scene: 干粉灭火剂打断链式反应的示意
shots.prompt_en: Dry powder particles break the chain reaction links in a flame diagram. No text.
shots.narration: 化学抑制：干粉等打断链式反应。

shots.section_title: 火灾按燃烧物分六类
shots.scene: 六个格子：A、B、C、D、E、F，各配图标
shots.prompt_en: Six boxes with icons: wood, liquid drop, gas cylinder, metal block, plug, frying pan. No text.
shots.narration: 火灾分六类：A固体、B液体、C气体。

shots.section_title: 火灾按燃烧物分六类
shots.scene: 六个格子中 D、E、F 三格亮起
shots.prompt_en: The metal block, plug and frying pan boxes of the six-box chart light up. No text.
shots.narration: D金属、E带电、F烹饪油脂。

shots.section_title: 火灾按燃烧物分六类
shots.scene: 国标封面图标，旁边有不同的外国分类打叉
shots.prompt_en: A national standard book icon gets a check; a different foreign chart is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按国家标准分类，与国外不同。

shots.section_title: 火灾按燃烧物分六类
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校灭火器铭牌特写，镜头停在适用火灾类别标识上（近景，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a fire extinguisher label area with fire class icons. No text.
shots.narration: 看清灭火器标签，适用哪类火。

shots.section_title: A类：固体物质火灾
shots.scene: 木材、纸张、棉布燃烧，留下灼热余烬
shots.prompt_en: Wood, paper and cotton cloth burn and leave glowing embers. No people.
shots.narration: A类：固体物质火灾。

shots.section_title: A类：固体物质火灾
shots.scene: 实验室角落堆着纸箱和废纸
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes and waste paper piled in a lab corner. No people.
shots.narration: 纸箱、擦拭纸，都是A类可燃物。

shots.section_title: A类：固体物质火灾
shots.scene: 纸箱被清出实验室，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes are carried out of the lab, getting a green check. No faces.
shots.narration: 包装纸箱，及时清出实验室。

shots.section_title: B类：液体和可熔化固体火灾
shots.scene: 溶剂瓶倾倒，液面着火
shots.prompt_en: A tipped solvent bottle spills and the liquid surface catches fire. No people.
shots.narration: B类：液体或可熔化固体火灾。
overlay: B类：液体和可熔化固体火灾

shots.section_title: B类：液体和可熔化固体火灾
shots.scene: 汽油、乙醇、石蜡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuel can, an ethanol bottle and a paraffin wax block. No text.
shots.narration: 汽油、乙醇、溶剂，还有石蜡。

shots.section_title: C类气体、D类金属火灾
shots.scene: 气瓶阀口喷出火焰
shots.prompt_en: A flame jets from a gas cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: C类：气体火灾，如甲烷、氢气。

shots.section_title: C类气体、D类金属火灾
shots.scene: 金属钠块燃烧，旁边泼水打叉
shots.prompt_en: A piece of sodium metal burns; pouring water on it is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: D类：钾、钠、镁等金属火灾。

shots.section_title: C类气体、D类金属火灾
shots.scene: 干砂覆盖燃烧的金属
shots.prompt_en: Dry sand is poured over burning metal. No faces.
shots.narration: 金属火不能用水，用干砂或专用灭火剂。

shots.section_title: E类带电、F类烹饪油脂火灾
shots.scene: 插着电源的设备冒火
shots.prompt_en: A plugged-in lab instrument with a small fire at its power cord. No people.
shots.narration: E类：带电设备火灾。
overlay: E类带电、F类烹饪油脂火灾

shots.section_title: E类带电、F类烹饪油脂火灾
shots.scene: 先拉闸断电，火灾类别随之改变
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the main power; the plug icon changes to the burning material icon. No faces.
shots.narration: 断电以后，按燃烧物本身处理。

shots.section_title: E类带电、F类烹饪油脂火灾
shots.scene: 带电设备上泼水打叉，水流导电的示意
shots.prompt_en: Throwing water on a burning powered device is crossed out; an electric arc travels along the water. No people.
shots.narration: 带电时不能用水和泡沫扑救。

shots.section_title: E类带电、F类烹饪油脂火灾
shots.scene: 炒锅里的食用油着火
shots.prompt_en: Cooking oil in a frying pan catches fire. No people.
shots.narration: F类：烹饪器具内的油脂火灾。

shots.section_title: 轰燃：火突然布满房间
shots.scene: 房间里热烟层在天花板下越积越厚
shots.prompt_en: A thick layer of hot smoke builds up under the ceiling of a room. No people.
shots.narration: 火越烧越大，热烟积在屋顶。

shots.section_title: 轰燃：火突然布满房间
shots.scene: 整个房间的可燃物突然同时起火
shots.prompt_en: All combustible items in the room suddenly ignite at once in a flash. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃物一齐起火，这就是轰燃。

shots.section_title: 轰燃：火突然布满房间
shots.scene: 浓烟中人形图标被熏倒的示意，烟雾打叉
shots.prompt_en: A figure icon is overcome in thick smoke, with a warning mark on the smoke. No faces.
shots.narration: 浓烟有毒，比火更快伤人。

shots.section_title: 轰燃：火突然布满房间
shots.scene: 人在轰燃前从门口撤离
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leaves through the door before the room flashes over.
shots.narration: 轰燃后很难逃生，必须提前撤离。

shots.section_title: 初起火灾好扑救，扑不灭就撤离报警
shots.scene: 火灾发展曲线：初起、发展、猛烈、衰减
shots.prompt_en: A fire growth curve rising through four stages with icons. No text.
shots.narration: 火灾初起时，最容易扑灭。
overlay: 初起火灾好扑救，扑不灭就撤离报警

shots.section_title: 初起火灾好扑救，扑不灭就撤离报警
shots.scene: 小火用灭火器扑救；火势变大，撤离并拨打119
shots.prompt_en: A small fire is put out with an extinguisher; a bigger fire makes people evacuate and call. No text.
shots.narration: 扑不灭就撤，拨打119。

shots.section_title: 初起火灾好扑救，扑不灭就撤离报警
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接到报告
shots.prompt_en: The security officer receives a phone report at the campus security desk.
shots.narration: 同时报告老师和学校保卫处。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 燃烧四面体和四种灭火方法依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: The fire tetrahedron and four extinguishing method icons get green checks. No text.
shots.narration: 四要素缺一不燃，灭火就拿掉一个。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: A到F六类图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Six fire class icons from wood to frying pan get green checks one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 火灾六类，按国标认清楚。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台旁关掉加热板，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot switches off a hot plate beside a tidy bench and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲实验室火灾的预防。
